title: PWM Interface
text: Simulate pulse width modulation (PWM) output from hardware, 1 input, 6 outputs, {Generate on} sets Generate; {PWM waveform period (s)} sets the period of PWM, {Output mode}, {Counter mode} sets the counter waveform, {Sampling mode}, {Dead time (s)} sets the dead band switching, {At position of period} sets the signal change at position, {At compare n} sets the signal change at comparator n, {At compare n direction count} sets the signal change at comparator n, {Phase offset in degree (0-360)} sets the pWM waveform offset scalar, {Type}, {ADC start condition} sets the trigger mode relative to PWM waveform End of PWM, {Number of replicas} sets the generate replica event ports, {PWM interrupt condition} sets the trigger mode relative to PWM waveform End of PWM and {Interrupt latency (s)} sets the interrupt generation latency. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: dCycle
ports.summary: Analog approximation of pulse-width-modulated signal scalar

ports.name: event
ports.summary: Event emitted on each PWM cycle scalar

ports.name: event n
ports.summary: Replicate event emitted on each PWM cycle scalar

ports.name: interrupt
ports.summary: Interrupt event emitted on each PWM cycle scalar

params.name: PWM waveform period (s)
params.values: Period of PWM waveform 50e-6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Sampling mode
params.values: Sampling mode End of PWM period (default) | Mid or End of PWM period | Immediate (at compare matches)

params.name: Dead time (s)
params.values: Dead band switching delay 1e-6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: At position of period
params.values: Signal change at position in period High | Low | Change | NoChange

params.name: At compare n
params.values: Signal change at comparator n trigger High | Low | Change | NoChange

params.name: At compare n direction count
params.values: Signal change at comparator n trigger High | Low | Change | NoChange

params.name: Phase offset in degree (0-360)
params.values: PWM waveform offset scalar from 0 to 360

params.name: Type
params.values: Type of events to generate ADC start (default) | PWM interrupt | ADC start and PWM interrupt

params.name: ADC start condition
params.values: Trigger mode relative to PWM waveform End of PWM period (default) | Mid of PWM period | Mid or End of PWM period | Compare 1 up count | Compare 1 down count | Compare 2 up count | Compare 2 down count

params.name: Generate on
params.values: Generate event on multiple of PWM update 1st event (default) | n th event | 16th event

params.name: Number of replicas
params.values: Generate replica event ports 1 (default) | integer from 1 to 16

params.name: PWM interrupt condition
params.values: Trigger mode relative to PWM waveform End of PWM period (default) | Mid of PWM period | Mid or End of PWM period | Compare 1 up count | Compare 1 down count | Compare 2 up count | Compare 2 down count
